title: XQS Citrus Cooling Nicotine Pouches - 8mg/Pouch
description: XQS Citrus Cooling tastes bright and zesty, blending Lemon and Lime style Citrus notes with a gentle minty coolness for a crisp, tidy profile. Each slim, all‑white pouch fits neatly under the lip and releases nicotine gradually without smoke, vapour or noticeable odour. This can contains 20 pouches in 8mg (Strong). Developed by XQS in Sweden, the range focuses on clean flavour and straightforward strength choices in a discreet format. Nicotine Ranges: Strong - 8mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Place one pouch under your upper lip and leave it in place for 20–40 minutes while the flavour and nicotine release gradually. When finished, remove the pouch and dispose of it responsibly. Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
